description: This file defines a web scraper class 'AberleHome' for extracting recipe data from 'aberlehome.com', including methods for retrieving ingredients, title, author, category, times, description, instructions, ratings, yields, and nutrients. It also imports utility functions and exception handling.

classes.name: AberleHome
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from aberlehome.com, extending AbstractScraper.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname 'aberlehome.com' for the scraper.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Retrieves the list of ingredients, falling back to HTML parsing if schema method returns empty.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe title, using schema or HTML fallback.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Retrieves the author, checking schema or HTML meta tag.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe category, using schema or HTML parsing.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Retrieves total time, with schema or HTML fallback.

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Retrieves cooking time, with schema or HTML fallback.

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Retrieves preparation time, with schema or HTML fallback.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Retrieves recipe description, with schema or HTML fallback.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Retrieves cooking instructions, with schema or HTML fallback.

methods.name: ratings
methods.description: Retrieves recipe ratings, with schema or HTML fallback.

methods.name: ratings_count
methods.description: Retrieves total ratings count, with schema or HTML fallback.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Retrieves recipe yields, with schema or HTML fallback.

methods.name: nutrients
methods.description: Retrieves nutrients information, populating missing data from HTML if schema returns empty.
